run_steps.name: run-01-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m py_compile sscontrol.py test_sscontrol.py fetch_mods.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/compile.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-02-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python fetch_mods.py > /out/fetch.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/fetch.txt; sha256sum sscontrol.py test_sscontrol.py dmcratio.py aprime_cross.py aleph-fig5.json aleph-dmc21.json aleph-emu3.json | tee /out/sha256.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-03-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m unittest -v test_aprime_cross test_dmcratio test_sscontrol > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-04-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python sscontrol.py --fig5 aleph-fig5.json --dmc aleph-dmc21.json --emu aleph-emu3.json --out /out > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/run.txt; exit $rc
